newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices barely changed Monday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices barely changed Monday.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices were barely changed in light after-hours trade Monday, as traders avoided deals until the release of Tuesday's U.S. inventory data, traders said.
"We've been flipping and flopping in a narrow range," one trader said.
Crude oil for May delivery traded $19.90 a barrel several hours into ACCESS, unchanged from the close of daytime trade, amid volume of 423 lots in May and 767 in total.
Traders said key price levels to watch Tuesday include $20.25, the resistance level, and $19.85 a barrel, the support level.
After-hours, NYMEX May heating oil traded at 54.75 cents, an 0.08-cent increase from the daytime settle. A light 33 lots traded in May, with 81 contracts exchanged overall.
Unleaded gasoline for May delivery changed hands at 62.05 cents gallon, a slight gain of 0.09 cents a gallon from the settle as 17 lots traded in the nearby month and 29 changed hands in total.
